_purpose: Published API list prices used to convert measured token counts into an API-list-price-equivalent cost per cell. Every rate is sourced; nothing is interpolated. Configurations whose model has no published per-token price carry cost = null rather than an estimate.

anthropic.reported_fields: Per assistant turn the transcript reports DISJOINT buckets: input_tokens (uncached), cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens (split by TTL in cache_creation), output_tokens. They are summed over turns.
anthropic.cache_write_note: Cache WRITES are a premium over base input: 1.25x at 5-minute TTL, 2.0x at 1-hour TTL. Measured: 100% of writes in this campaign are ephemeral_1h_input_tokens, so the 2.0x rate applies. Earlier cost code omitted cache writes entirely and undercounted accordingly.
anthropic.thinking_note: Reasoning/thinking tokens bill as ordinary output tokens (no surcharge) and are already inside output_tokens.

openai.reported_fields: The rollout reports CUMULATIVE total_token_usage; the last record is taken. cached_input_tokens is a SUBSET of input_tokens, and reasoning_output_tokens is a SUBSET of output_tokens (verified: input+output == total_tokens exactly).
openai.double_count_warning: Charging input_tokens in full AND cached_input_tokens separately double-counts the cached prefix (3.09M of 3.24M tokens on a sampled cell).
openai.cache_write_note: No cache-write charge is published; caching is automatic. The 3-tuple is structurally complete for OpenAI and structurally incomplete for Anthropic.

_sources.openai_crosscheck: https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/pricing (Codex credit rate card; 1 credit = $0.04 — independently reproduces every OpenAI row)

claude-sonnet-5.price_caveat: Introductory pricing through 2026-08-31; standard rates are 3.00 / 0.30 / 6.00 / 15.00 from 2026-09-01. Rates here are as-checked on 2026-07-27.

gpt-5.3-codex-spark.unpriced_reason: Research preview for ChatGPT Pro; not available in the API at launch and absent from the published API pricing table. Third-party aggregators quote the base gpt-5.3-codex rate for it; that is not an OpenAI-published Spark price and is not used here.

codex_extension_waves.note: Every codex wave ran with `-c service_tier=fast`. Resolution: `fast` is not an OpenAI API service tier at all — it is a ChatGPT-side credit feature (https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/agent-configuration/speed), and the CLI logged that it omitted the parameter as unsupported for gpt-5.6, so requests ran at the default tier. Authentication was ChatGPT-subscription (no API key), so actual consumption was ChatGPT credits at a 2.5x fast multiplier for GPT-5.6/5.5 — a rate with NO published per-token dollar price. That does not affect the figure here, which reports an API-list-price EQUIVALENT: measured tokens converted at published list rates, not an invoice. OpenAI's paid Priority tier (2x standard on all categories) was not used.
codex_extension_waves.status: RESOLVED — standard list rates are the correct basis

claude_extension_waves.note: No fast-mode flag was set. Anthropic fast mode is double-gated (speed:'fast' plus the fast-mode-2026-02-01 beta header, research-preview access) and supports only Opus 5 and Opus 4.8 — Fable 5 has no fast rate at all. Standard rates therefore apply. Anthropic's own service_tier is a capacity commitment, not a per-token premium, and is unsupported on Opus 5 / Sonnet 5 regardless.
claude_extension_waves.status: RESOLVED — standard list rates are the correct basis

original_waves.flags: codex --yolo -c mcp_servers={} (tier per the July record); claude --dangerously-skip-permissions --model <model> --effort <effort>

_price_provenance.caveat: These are the rates as published on the check date. The original waves ran 2026-07-01..03; no attempt was made to establish historical rates for that window, so a rate change in between would mean the earlier cost figures were correct at their time and merely stale now. All costs in compilation.json are computed on the check-date rates so that every row is comparable on one basis.
_price_provenance.opus_tiers: Opus 4.5, Opus 4.8 and Opus 5 all bill identically ($5 / $0.50 / $25) as checked. They are kept as separate entries so a future divergence is a one-line change. Fable 5 is distinct at $10 / $1 / $50.
_price_provenance.superseded_model: Earlier cost code applied $15 / $1.50 / $75 to any config whose name began with 'opus' — the historical Opus-generation rate, matching no current Opus tier — and had no entry for Fable 5 at all.
